identity.canonical_encoding: utf-8 JSON with sorted keys and separators ',' ':'

transformations.Setup: Reset to the declared initial state and bind the sealed fixture identity. Expected outcomes are not supplied to the adapter.
transformations.Rule: Translate each fixture event, without reordering or mutation, into one step and append it to the event log while monotonically advancing generation.
transformations.Link: After the final rule, bind the fixture id and replay digest as provenance links. Canonical expected state is resolved only across the verifier boundary.

verifier_boundary.held_out_input: A verifier-owned mapping from sealed scenario id to expected canonical outcome.
verifier_boundary.acceptance: Direct fixture replay and adapter replay must yield byte-identical canonical outcomes and equal SHA-256 hashes after save/restore.
